title: Agent rooms: roles_list without role 0; empty policy_component_ids (clean-room C8)
description: Clean-room C8: mimid-agent's own rooms name roles banned/member/admin but leave out role 0 (no_role), and give an empty policy_component_ids in base_room_policy although a roles_list is present. room-policy-04 §5: policy_component_ids lists 'the Component IDs of the other policy components that are relevant to this room ..., including the roles_list'. Fix room creation; check role 0 rules in room-policy-04 §3. Mark 2026-11-21.
close_reason: 14b67756: role 0 not required (room-policy-04 §3 reserves index 0 for non-participants; used only as from_role_index / canOpenJoin holder), so agent rooms leave it out; policy_component_ids already lists roles_list since 24a2bfd. For the new draft's octet-match rule the agent now gives the role named 'member' (invite, unban, JMAP role change) instead of index 2.
